# Third-party notices

## Roboto Condensed

The unmodified Regular and Bold fonts are Roboto Condensed version 2.137 (2017),
copyright 2011 Google Inc., designed by Christian Robertson, and licensed under
Apache License 2.0. The full license and original notice are in `licenses/`.
Font origins and checksums are recorded in `assets.json`.

## Theme and textures

The theme and surface masks originate from derk's supplied Cream and Ink UI
export. The reusable web implementation keeps those masks, colors, and font
assets together; it has no dependency on a game runtime.

The bundled Apache license applies to the fonts. No separate blanket license
has been selected for the project-specific theme code, artwork, or documentation.
